— The Process

Three steps. Total recall.

Step 01
Point Lore at your repo

Paste any public GitHub URL. Lore pulls every commit, PR, issue, and comment — the full institutional history of your codebase, ingested in minutes.

await cognee.remember(repo_url)
Step 02
Cognee builds the graph

History is structured into a hybrid graph-vector knowledge graph. Relationships between decisions, contributors, and code are permanently mapped and linked.

graph + vector → knowledge
Step 03
Interrogate. Forever.

Ask anything about your codebase's past. Lore recalls across infinite sessions — memory persists, context never dies, and every answer cites its sources.

await cognee.recall(question)
— Memory Lifecycle

Four operations.
Nothing forgotten.

remember()

Ingest commits, PRs, and issues into the knowledge graph. Every piece of history, permanently structured and linked.

recall()

Ask anything. Cognee routes between semantic search and deep graph traversals to surface the right answer with full source citations.

improve()

Enrich memory after new commits. Prune stale nodes. The graph gets smarter every time your codebase evolves.

forget()

Surgically remove deprecated branches or outdated context. Lore only carries what matters.
